استأتوا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْتَوْا (istaʔtaw) /is.taʔ.taw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# اِسْتَأْتُوا (istaʔtū) /is.taʔ.tuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
